comments.body: Code size limits for tests: are we forcing current limit of 24k/48k? Some tests already exercise the 64k limit.
Add to spec updates - https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/pull/124 - EXTDELEGATECALL clarified to fail when calling non-eof, (as opposed to actual legacy contracts)

Re 24k/48k/64k it's a question of where we enforce it.  

For returncontract do we enforce it in the opcode or let the storage system tell us no-bueno?  

For EOFCREATE in theory the Create Transaction should have filtered it pre-execution, and factory contracts are already size limited to runtime sizes. A TXCREATE opcode would need to check, but again the transaction processor should have filtered it out?

Proposal to ban subcontainers that only REVERT/INVALID and can be referenced by both EOFCREATE and RETURNCONTRACT. Two options:
1. Require each subcontainer to have STOP or RETURN or RETURNCONTRACT.
2. Disallow EOFCREATE and RETURNCONTRACT referencing the same container.

(option 2 would still allow containers that only have REVERT)

## Notes (by @pdobacz )

### client updates:
#### geth

- ~60/1000 tests failing, making progress

#### evmone

- merged RETURNDATACOPY oob, Creation TX, ASE EXT*CALL, initcode mode validation in progress

#### besu

- progress on testing support

### compiler updates
None

### spec updates:

- https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/issues/118 / https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/issues/119:
- ended up not discussing these again, not in favor of either option, both have problems as documented in the issues.
- https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/issues/117
- no action to be taken for the reasons noted therein. If necessary, Solidity to make a stronger request for it.
- code size limiting in eof validation (to MAX_INITCODE_SIZE)
- Ipsilon to write down a PR, solidity testing might be a practical problem, could be solved by having the limit at 2xMAX_INITCODE_SIZE
- ban subcontainers with only revert/invalid (https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1055#issuecomment-2150340561)
- Option 2 more favorable, vyper mentions signaling contracts are legit use case

### testing updates:

- EIP versioning:
  - Generally in favor of changelog stopgap solution to version EIPs and check their versions in testing
  - EIPIP also in favor, possibly a preamble entry in the future.
- feature-forks:
  - Testing team shows off support in EEST for feature-forks (CancunEIP7692 for example) to fill&release only tests related to a feature (EOF in this case)

[EIP-7577: Versioning Scheme for EIPs](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7577) was also discussed in the following [EIPIP meeting](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5yhgfqMWg_M&t=945s) today.

The proposal is merged as `Draft` however a few editors had [concerns](https://github.com/ethcatherders/EIPIP/issues/337#issuecomment-2151133185) related to the adoption of the EIP.

Adding comments to [proposal discussion](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/add-eip-versioning-scheme-for-eips/17295) will be helpful to move the proposal to the next status.
